text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black delivered a stellar 
performance in the Kikuka Sho. Running so 
fiercely that no one noticed Brusquemaen's 
absence, she deeply moved the fans' 
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Kitasan Black run a magnificent 
race, Sakura Bakushin O felt her role had 
come to an end and took her leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as if answering Kitasan Black's 
brilliant run, Satono Diamond claimed 
victory in her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's next goal is the Arima 
Kinen. Dreaming of reuniting with Satono 
Diamond next year, she steps onto this 
grand stage first on her own.
